The '''Ipellrilla system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]], part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the system to the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Fornax/Legends|Fornax]] and [[Nentan]]. The Ipellrilla system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Ipellrilla firewater]] beverage.<ref name="PA">{{JournalCite|3|The Pentastar Alignment}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ipellrilla firewater]]|system=Ipellrilla [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ipellrilla system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-7.<ref name="TEA" />
